policy_metadata.policy_title: Laboratory – Testing for Alpha1 Anti-trypsin Deficiency

sections.heading: Medicare Advantage Payment Policy
content: As a Medicare Advantage plan, we have developed payment policies to explain coverage more fully for services. The criteria outlined will apply to Medicare Advantage plans as outlined below. In addition to this policy, claims payments are subject to other plan requirements for the processing and payment of claims, including, but not limited to, requirements of medical necessity and reasonableness and applicable referral or authorization requirements.

1. Serum quantification of alpha-1 antitrypsin (A1AT) protein (CPT code 82103) and A1AT phenotyping by isoelectric focusing or A1AT proteotyping (Pi-typing or protease inhibitor typing) for Z and S alleles by liquid chromatography-tandem mass spectrometry (CPT code 82104) ARE ONLY REIMBURSABLE in any of the following situations: • Individuals with emphysema, COPD, chronic bronchitis, bronchiectasis, or asthma • Individuals with liver disease • Individuals with necrotizing panniculitis • Individuals with vasculitis • Individuals with neonatal cholestasis • Family history of alpha-1 antitrypsin (AAT) deficiency or diseases of the blood and blood-forming organs or endocrine, nutritional, and metabolic diseases or genetic disease Applicable procedures for Medicare Advantage plans
